legends: Time offset in between local system and reference clock

metrics.label: Time offset in between local system and reference clock

kibana.query:
TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_timex_estimated_error_seconds IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_timex_offset_seconds IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_timex_maxerror_seconds IS NOT NULL
| STATS Estimated_error_in_seconds = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_timex_estimated_error_seconds)), Time_offset_in_between_local_system_and_reference_clock = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_timex_offset_seconds)), Maximum_error_in_seconds = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_timex_maxerror_seconds)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.instance, labels.job
| KEEP time_bucket, `labels.instance`, `labels.job`, Estimated_error_in_seconds, Time_offset_in_between_local_system_and_reference_clock, Maximum_error_in_seconds
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_timex_loop_time_constant IS NOT NULL
| STATS node_timex_loop_time_constant = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_timex_loop_time_constant)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.instance, labels.job
| SORT time_bucket ASC

legends: Is clock synchronized to a reliable server (1 = yes, 0 = no)

metrics.label: Is clock synchronized to a reliable server (1 = yes, 0 = no)

kibana.query:

| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_timex_sync_status IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_timex_frequency_adjustment_ratio IS NOT NULL
| STATS Is_clock_synchronized_to_a_reliable_server_1_yes_0_no = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_timex_sync_status)), Local_clock_frequency_adjustment = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_timex_frequency_adjustment_ratio)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.instance, labels.job
| KEEP time_bucket, `labels.instance`, `labels.job`, Is_clock_synchronized_to_a_reliable_server_1_yes_0_no, Local_clock_frequency_adjustment
| SORT time_bucket ASC
